description: Copy a file or directory locally, upload/download through SFTP, or relay between named targets; may overwrite destination files

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Local path or target:/path; one literal path, no remote globs

parameters.name: destination
parameters.description: Local path or target:/path; existing files may be overwritten

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: With --on TARGET, read source from that target instead of uploading

parameters.name: preserve
parameters.description: Preserve source times/mode where permitted; --preserve=false disables it
